description: This PHP file defines the AccessEmployeeFileController class in the OrangeHRM system, which handles downloading employee data in JSON format within the maintenance module. It manages user permissions, interacts with maintenance services, and formats employee data for download.

classes.name: AccessEmployeeFileController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling the download of employee data in JSON format, managing permissions, and formatting response content.

methods.name: getDownloadFormat
methods.description: Provides singleton instance of JsonDownloadFormat used for formatting employee data for download.

methods.name: getMaintenanceService
methods.description: Provides singleton instance of MaintenanceService for accessing employee maintenance data.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main method to process the HTTP request, check permissions, retrieve employee data, and prepare JSON response for download.
